hints.title: Hostname Isolation Graph Traversal
hints.text: Only crawl web links that share the exact same hostname as the initial starting address.

hints.title: Hostname Parser and Visited Set
hints.text: Extract the hostname prefix following http://. Run standard breadth-first search and filter discovered links by hostname.

hints.title: Crawler Queue Blueprint
hints.text: Seed queue and visited set with startUrl. For each polled url, fetch links with htmlParser.getUrls and enqueue unvisited matches.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: V: total distinct URLs on same hostname
complexity.notes: Each unique hostname URL is processed once through the queue.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing external links leads to unbounded web exploration outside the target host.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited hash set avoids infinite cyclic loops across mutually linking pages.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct hostname URL parsing and BFS traversal with visited deduplication.
